newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador banana exports up 0.31 pct in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador banana exports up 0.31 pct in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Ecuador's banana exports were 3.15 million tonnes in the first 10 months of 1996, up 0.31 percent from the comparable 1995 period, the National Banana Program (PNB) said Friday.
In the first 10 months of 1995, Ecuador exported 3.14 million tonnes.
PNB added that Ecuador earned $784 million from banana exports in the 1996 period, up from $710.8 million.
Ecuador, the world's top banana exporter, exported 3.3 million tonnes in 1994 and 3.7 million tonnes in 1995.

The European Union was the largest buyer of Ecuador's bananas in the 10 months, buying 1.17 million tonnes for $297.1 million, while the United States was second, importing 734,532 tonnes for $186.2 million.
